rules.title: Resource-oriented URLs
rules.text: Model APIs around plural nouns (/orders/{id}) and use HTTP methods for actions instead of verbs in paths.

rules.title: Correct status codes
rules.text: Return accurate status codes: 2xx for success, 4xx for caller mistakes, 5xx for server faults.

rules.title: Consistent error body
rules.text: Return errors in one consistent shape with a machine-readable code, a human message and a request ID.

rules.title: Version breaking changes
rules.text: Never change a published API incompatibly; add a new version or a new field instead.

rules.title: Cursor pagination
rules.text: Paginate list endpoints with cursors or limit and offset, and bound the maximum page size.

rules.title: Idempotent writes
rules.text: Make retried writes safe with idempotency keys or naturally idempotent operations.

rules.title: Keep the OpenAPI spec
rules.text: Keep the OpenAPI schema as the source of truth and update it in the same change as the endpoint.

rules.title: Validate against the schema
rules.text: Validate requests and responses against the declared schema and reject unknown fields where appropriate.

rules.title: Rate limiting
rules.text: Apply rate limits to public and expensive endpoints and return 429 with a Retry-After header.

rules.title: Consistent field naming
rules.text: Use one casing for JSON fields across the API and ISO 8601 UTC timestamps.

rules.title: Do not leak internals
rules.text: Do not expose database IDs, stack traces or internal error text through the API.
